item.text: The source confirms the cleanup caveat: a failed child-session save can prevent settlement from reaching controller cleanup. I’ll keep that condition explicit and organize the tree around turns, tool calls, and independent alternatives, with concise handoffs to the agent API, saved contexts, and evaluations.

{"ascii":"Agent Chat Orchestration: persisted conversations coordinate turns and isolated alternatives
|-- [M] Boundaries and dependencies
|   |-- AgentChatPanel -> HTTP routes -> AgentChatService
|   |   |-- Public contract: create/resume, send/read canvas, answer, interrupt and generate
|   |   `-- Service keeps session/thread indexes, request tracking and concurrency guards private
|   |-- Service -> ChatStore for persistence; CodexConnection for native threads and events
|   |   `-- StdioCodexConnection hides process startup, JSON framing and RPC correlation
|   |-- Service -> ChatDiagramTools -> agent API for canvas operations
|   |   `-- Adapter exposes tool definitions/calls; target resolution and retry preparation stay internal
|   `-- GenerationCanvasBridge exposes CanvasSessionPort
|       |-- Live canvas commands -> delegate to supplied live port
|       `-- Candidate commands -> private controller; reject mismatched or inactive bindings
|-- [C] Conversation turns: durable session, transient activation
|   |-- Create -> thread/start with chat instructions/tools -> save chatId + native threadId
|   |-- Resume(native threadId) -> reuse existing import or thread/resume
|   |   |-- Preserve native instructions, history, cwd and model; reject an active native thread
|   |   `-- Imported chat starts without canvas tools; idle reload can refresh tools through MCP
|   |-- Send / Read Canvas -> startTurn; reject overlapping start, turn or tool reload
|   |   |-- [D] Model input requires text + captured references, or the canvas reader's short response
|   |   |-- Capture canvas target/references for this turn -> bind tools with selected access
|   |   `-- Save client requestId before turn/start; a known ID returns without another start
|   |       `-- Panel retains the same request after a lost response; this prevents duplicate dispatch
|   |-- App-server event -> threadId resolves chatId -> reduce session state -> notify listeners
|   |   |-- Text deltas are batched; SSE sends initial snapshot/parts followed by live updates
|   |   |-- Routes omit tool definitions, generation receipts and generation.history
|   |   |   `-- Large completed tool items have snapshot previews; item endpoint supplies full detail
|   |   |-- Question/approval -> pending request -> panel answer -> respond to native request
|   |   `-- turn/completed -> settle open items/questions -> save idle, interrupted or failed state
|   `-- [O] UI subscription lifetime differs from conversation lifetime
|       |-- Changing selected chat closes its EventSource/buffer; response close releases subscription
|       `-- Closing a tab keeps the conversation in service/store history
|-- [C] Turn-bound tools: carry captured context across the agent API boundary
|   |-- Native tool request -> validate registered tool and running turn; check turnId when known
|   |-- Bound HTTP request -> token resolves chat; require running chat with tools and no reload
|   `-- dispatchTool(name, input, cloned chat/access/canvas context)
|       |-- gen-alternatives -> managed generation below
|       `-- Other tools -> ChatDiagramTools.call
|           |-- Mutation requires writable access; selected references resolve against current state
|           |-- [D] Direct edit input requires one canvas document snapshot + resolved operations
|           |   `-- Carry document expectedVersion and each target diagram's baseRevisionId separately
|           |-- Chat-scoped retry identity -> reuse prepared input; changed arguments fail
|           `-- submitDirect/call -> agent API; edit status/cancel requires this chat's recorded run ownership
|-- Independent alternatives: prepare once, execute separately, publish retained results
|   |-- [C] genAlternatives requires writable parent, tools, a user message and source canvas
|   |   |-- Reject nested generation; generated chats are retained for review, not further sends
|   |   `-- Parent chat + requestId identifies receipt; signature mismatch rejects conflicting retry
|   |-- Prepare -> persist children and parent receipt -> request candidate views at source document version
|   |   `-- Retain returned source history and a separate inputHistory snapshot before launch
|   |-- [D] Each candidate result depends on
|   |   |-- Shared captured source history [H] + that candidate's applied edits
|   |   |-- Shared task + candidate prompt + inherited model/effort settings
|   |   `-- Saved AgentContext snapshot OR forked conversation with trigger/references
|   |       `-- Sibling results are not inputs to one another
|   |-- [C] Schedule child launches together; branch order does not imply execution order
|   |   |-- Saved context -> thread/start -> inject snapshot as captured reference material
|   |   |   `-- Metadata retains AgentContext ID and content hash
|   |   |-- Otherwise -> thread/fork before active parent turn, or through retained last turn
|   |   `-- Clear inherited goal -> bind isolated canvas -> start one managed candidate turn
|   |-- [O] Bridge creates one controller per active candidate from [H], with a fresh contextId
|   |   |-- Separate thread, canvas binding and controller keep candidate edits independent
|   |   |-- Queue serializes commands; supported mutations enforce document/revision checks
|   |   `-- Cache mutation receipt -> export history -> callback saves history into child session
|   |       `-- Identical retry after callback failure retries persistence without reapplying mutation
|   `-- [C] finishGeneration separates result retention from publication
|       |-- Classify finished/failed/cancelled -> capture controller history -> await child-session save
|       |   `-- If this save fails, execution never reaches the publication cleanup finally block
|       |-- After save, syncGeneration invokes two distinct publication boundaries
|       |   |-- Evaluation observer receives children grouped by runId + parent; errors are caught
|       |   |   `-- Registration also replays retained runs; evaluation internals belong to the consumer
|       |   `-- Source canvas receives candidate viewId + terminal metadata
|       |       |-- Finished includes result history; failed/cancelled omits result history
|       |       `-- Reconnect may resolve live canvas ID from stable workspace ID + documentId
|       |-- Canvas sync failure -> retain child result and report pending save
|       |   `-- Later generations query retries terminal publication with stable request identity
|       `-- Publication attempt's finally -> clear binding, remove controller, attempt thread unsubscribe
|           `-- Persisted child/history survives controller removal; reruns reuse retained inputs
`-- [O] Interruption and process failure
    |-- Parent interrupt attempts cancellation of active children, then interrupts its own turn
    |-- Connection owns app-server process and pending RPCs; process loss rejects outstanding calls
    |   `-- Service clears bindings/resume state, fails active work and attempts generation settlement
    |-- Server reload marks running chats/items interrupted and active generations failed
    `-- Service disposal saves interruption state, clears bindings and disposes the connection"}
